body:
The license **does** seem to meet the _definitive factors_ of the [SPDX license inclusion principles](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-XML/blob/master/DOCS/license-inclusion-principles.md).

Regarding the _other factors_ (in descending order of importance):

1. it is **not** compliant with any OSD, FSD, etc. definition, esp. through its limitation to be used only by “individuals and organizations that do not operate by capitalist principles”
2. it **is** structured to be used by anyone (see caveat above)
3. it **can be argued** that the license has some substantial use. A quick search shows about [140 occurrences where this license pops up on GitHub](https://github.com/search?p=15&q=This+is+anti-capitalist+software%2C+released+for+free+use+by+individuals+and+organizations+that+do+not+operate+by+capitalist+principles.&type=Code). At first glance, I did not find any important project among them. (For comparison, there seem to be [cca. 980 occurrences of the Hippocratic License](https://github.com/search?p=99&q=%22hippocratic+license%22&type=Code))
4. I would **argue that it does not** meet this criterion, as the limiting criterion seems to be quite exclusive (see quoted below)
5. I **cannot tell** what the license steward’s position is on their license being included in the SPDX License List. The submitter is not one of the stewards.

> This is anti-capitalist software, released for free use by individuals and organizations that do not operate by capitalist principles.
> […]
> 
> 2. The User is one of the following:
> a. An individual person, laboring for themselves
> b. A non-profit organization
> c. An educational institution
> d. An organization that seeks shared profit for all of its members, and allows non-members to set the cost of their labor
> 
> 3. If the User is an organization with owners, then all owners are workers and all workers are owners with equal equity and/or equal vote.
> 
> 4. If the User is an organization, then the User is not law enforcement or military, or working for or under either.

---

I would tend towards not including this license. Its limitations seem stricter than that of _Hippocratic-2.1_ and its use is also much smaller. But do not have strong feelings either way about it.

discussed on April 29 legal call
- all agreed with the analysis and that it's too restrictive and shouldn't be added
- this license is drafted not really as a limited restriction but from a place of restriction and "only these people can use it"
please note, you can always use LicenseRef- (see section 6 of the SPDX Spec https://spdx.dev/wp-content/uploads/sites/41/2020/08/SPDX-specification-2-2.pdf ) to identify other licenses
